soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 (diffusion-poisson)
soundness_flags.one_line: A finite centered jump CTMC cannot literally have the diffusion generator L0 or Lγ; define the scaled paths and state a convergence-to-diffusion assertion instead.

soundness_flags.label: M_N definition and all results using Q1,N
soundness_flags.one_line: M_N is declared in {1,...,N-1}, but ceil(Na(p)+γ√N) need not lie there for every N under the maintained conditions; restrict the array to an explicit uniform N≥N0 or clip the design.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1 (kink-residual)
soundness_flags.one_line: {Q1,N-LγN}h evaluated at the scaled lattice state is undefined until the lattice lift of h and the corresponding scaled prelimit generator are specified.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 (certified-capacity-design)
soundness_flags.one_line: “Computable” real inputs, outward rounding, and certificate outputs Lε,Uε lack a representation/enclosure model, so algorithm termination and certified inequalities are not yet formal mathematical claims.
